calls.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. IMAGE 1 is the EXACT immutable ground footprint template; IMAGE 2 gives the architecture and texture style to rebuild. Produce one Ming northern Chinese small enclosed courtyard, with three single-storey hard-gabled grey tile wings and grey brick enclosure, plain central wood gate. Match the photoreal painted game-asset detail of image 2. Geometry is the sole correction: trace the entire perimeter of image 1 EXACTLY, then build the same courtyard upward INSIDE that polygon. DO NOT copy image2 camera or floor outline. Output canvas1536x1024. Ground corners in pixels: left(200,600), front(800,900), right(1280,660), back(680,360). This is a 10by8 rectangle. Every edge of both ground and buildings is parallel to either vector(2,1) or(2,-1); verticals remain vertical. Orthographic dimetric2:1, no perspective. Front-left base edge600right300down; front-right480right240up. Keep BOTH visible perimeter edges crisp straight and corners visible. Thin flush flagstone apron, no steps beyond its outline. Keep roofs within canvas, transparent margins. Upper-left lighting, subtle contact shadow toward lower-right entirely inside base. Real RGBA transparency outside silhouette, opaque stone and buildings. No people, signs, text, guide lines, checkerboard, scenery, modern objects, thick plinth or cropped roofs. Exact projection has highest priority.

Replace this rectangular block with an accurately aligned grey-brick Chinese Ming northern courtyard compound. Keep its two vertical side faces as courtyard wall locations, hollow out its center into an enclosed courtyard, add three small grey tiled hard-gable residential wings inside it and a front central wood gate. Fine realistic weathered brick/tile/wood game sprite texture, subdued color, sunlight from upper-left, no people. Most important: DO NOT change the block's silhouette at ground level, front vertex or axis angles. Ground silhouette must remain identical to reference. Left ground vertex(180,590), front(820,910), right(1332,654). The front-right base line must be exactly512px across256px up, angle26.565 degrees. Front-left is640px across320px down, ALSO26.565 degrees. No30degree isometric; precisely2:1dimetric. Width/depth=10/8. Place architecture inside this footprint, neat thin stone apron, corners and bottom outline exactly as block. Remove solid block cap, and no thick pedestal. Keep full roofs in frame. 1536x1024 transparent RGBA canvas, totally transparent background, no halo or scenery, no guides or text. Exact geometry before ornament.

qa.visual_review: 第3轮逐张view_image原目标、全部候选；选几何残差较低候选，最终图另复查。
